argument: Turn the Air is filed as an Adept card, but the one and only damage value anywhere in its three outcomes is a single point of cold (11-arcane-spells:476). The Adept row is 5/8/11, so the printed value sits four under its own row's floor. One is not a value any live row prints for a spell: it is the cantrip Weak number, exactly what Frost Touch prints at 11-arcane-spells:52. Fix path: either the Cold property carries the row's own first value, or the card declares the repeating chip as an exception the way the cantrip exemption is declared. Disposition: MECHANICAL if the value is a slip; DESIGN if a repeating per-turn area chip was intended, because that intent has no home in the band law. Arithmetic: Adept floor 5 against printed 1 gives 5 - 1 = 4 short; cantrip Weak value 1 equals the printed figure.

evidence.claim: The Cold property's one point of cold is the only damage figure in the card's three outcome lines (11-arcane-spells:476).
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: creatures starting their turn there take 1 cold damage

evidence.claim: Adept row 5/8/11 against the printed 1: 5 - 1 = 4 below the floor, so the figure can be keyed to no Adept value (11-arcane-spells:476).
Frost Touch, a cantrip, prints that same single point as its Weak value, so the Adept card reuses a cantrip number (11-arcane-spells:52).
